label: early copy-phase input of c/w/z/2/t in long (L>=8) sequences
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps, tiny magnitudes). It fires only in the copy phase, almost always while the model outputs original token 2-4 (t=10-13) of long sequences (L=8 or 9 hold about 97% of the mass), and only when the fed-back input token is c or w (about 70% of mass), or else z, 2 or t. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, and never on the first occurrence of a token. A small secondary cluster fires at the last copy step of L=9. Context modulates it: it is stronger when an h (or m, 1, x) came just before or opened the sequence, but adding those conditions loses recall without making it precise. The predicate covers about 85% of activation mass, yet precision is about 2%: most qualifying steps stay below threshold, so whatever decides threshold crossing is hidden-state context these variables do not capture.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=c (+4.86), phase=2 & in_tok=w (+3.94), phase=2 & in_tok=z (+3.40), phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+3.30), prev_tok=h (+2.44), prev_tok=m (+2.37). Lower it: to_go=1 (-2.02), orig8=- (-1.89), orig7=- (-1.82), recall_idx=5 (-1.82).
